title: Workshop: J2EE and advanced Java
summary: Volunteered an one-day hands-on workshop on j2ee and advanced java for about 80 students at Sir MVIT.
what_would_have_happened: Students learn the topic only from the syllabus, without an industry view of how it is used.
the_call: Give time outside work to bring working-engineer experience into the classroom.
what_i_did: Prepared and delivered the one-day hands-on workshop as a volunteer.

quotes.text: He has presented the technical sessions (JAVA/J2EE tech Seminar at Sir MVIT, MCA dept in even semester 2012) effectively in terms of reaching the students/staff so that they are ensured for rich continuous learning.
